name: OpenObserve AI monitoring OG card by AI Observability by OpenObserve
description: A 1200×630 social card built from a soft aurora gradient: blurred pastel blobs (mint upper-left, lavender upper-right, peach lower-right, pale blue lower-left) dissolve into a near-white centre, giving depth without any photographic content. The only element is a single centred lockup on both axes — a multicolour segmented ring with a white inner disc holding a black ECG-pulse glyph, paired with a lowercase near-black geometric-sans wordmark that carries a faint warm fade toward its lower right. No headline, tagline or URL competes for attention; roughly 40% of the canvas stays empty, and the dark-on-pastel contrast keeps the card legible at the small sizes chat apps render shared links.
